title: My Uncle NEVER Lies. He's Covered 🏷️
description:
Don't lie in this town. Every lie pins a small white tag on you. My uncle has never told a lie in his life, and he's covered in them. I've never had a single one.

I came home for a week to help him shut the little alterations shop where he taught me to cut. Every time a customer asks after me, another tag lands on him. And at night, someone keeps chalking up my old bench for a suit.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
